authority: Native Codex host executes agent inference. Deterministic CLI compiles briefs and validates submitted artifacts; it does not simulate inference.
tool_resolution: Discover actual host tool schemas each session. These are host capability names, not shell commands. Bind an equivalent native API only with observed capability metadata; never substitute thread creation or a fabricated subprocess transcript.
dispatch_semantics: Get a ready node and immutable dispatch brief using CLI dispatch.
Read the brief and pinned component entrypoints and permitted resources.
Spawn a fresh actual native subagent with fork_context=false, the scoped brief, immutable attempt identity, read/write scope, frozen inputs and requested effort; inherit model.
Use CLI bind to associate actual returned host agent id and receipt with that exact dispatch/attempt.
Wait for actual completion; preserve agent-reported issues and tool failures.
Build the result JSON from actual artifacts and host receipts using installed CLI/schema requirements.
CLI submit validates the envelope and current bindings. It does not constitute independent semantic review.
Dispatch independent reviewer with current artifact hashes, criteria and evidence; CLI review records the actually returned review.
Persist raw outputs before summaries; retain actual spawn/wait/result evidence.
Actually close completed workers and preserve successful close receipts; never resume completed workers for new tasks.
wire_format: Logical fields here document required information, not command argument spellings or a competing engine schema. Installed command --help and engine schemas are authoritative; do not manufacture undocumented flags.
check_result: Retain check identity, actual outcome (pass/fail/not-run/error), evidence artifact locator/hash, expected/actual values where meaningful, and actor. Empty reports cannot become passing checks.
review_binding: Review binds reviewer host identity, current artifact hashes, criterion version, scope actually inspected, issue-level findings and disposition. Distinct display names without actual independent agents are insufficient.
recovery: Inspect status. Continue only a still-active same-task worker through supported actions and its intact binding. Completed workers and new tasks require fresh attempts/actors with fork_context=false. Preserve old history and actual close receipts; never fabricate closure or rewrite bindings.

current_engine_mapping.binding: attempt_id, agent_id, provider=codex-native, instruction_sha256, model{requested,resolved,observed}, reasoning{requested,resolved,observed}, host_receipt{tool,response,captured_at}
current_engine_mapping.result: attempt_id, agent_id, artifacts[{name,type,path}], checks[{id,passed,evidence}], summary, usage
current_engine_mapping.review: id, attempt_id (target), reviewer_agent_id, review_task_attempt, role, targets[{name,sha256}], verdict, scope, evidence, findings
current_engine_mapping.nonpass_checks: Current result schema requires passed:boolean. Encode a required unperformed/error check as passed:false and preserve status=not-run/error plus evidence explaining what was not performed; never synthesize a successful observation. Use engine failure APIs instead when available.
current_engine_mapping.authority: This mapping documents the inspected development schema. Re-read installed schemas before writing requests; the installed schema is authoritative.
current_engine_mapping.receipt_tool: Engine canonical tool id is multi_agent_v1.spawn_agent. Actual transport may be tools.multi_agent_v1__spawn_agent; preserve transport name separately and preserve the actual spawn response unchanged.
current_engine_mapping.instruction_hash: Use returned dispatch.brief_sha256 for binding.instruction_sha256; hashing the response including brief_sha256 is incorrect.
current_engine_mapping.artifact_location: All submitted files must reside under dispatch.result_directory. artifact.type values cover node.outputs.
current_engine_mapping.review_order: Dispatch, bind and submit the independent review task before review records its verdict against the target attempt.
current_engine_mapping.requested_effort_source: Use frozen dispatch.node.reasoning at spawn, not a mutable policy default.
current_engine_mapping.snapshots: Register source and other input/approveddesign snapshots before dispatch; request references alone do not satisfy readiness.

effective_concurrency: min(package upper bound 6, confirmed host capacity, user/session limit); unknown capacity is not six; use conservative scheduling and actual host responses.
host_attestation: Actual agent_id and receipt hash must be attested by the host according to installed schema. This is cooperating-process integrity, not cryptographic identity. Never fabricate host attestation.
final_completion: Protected valuation-v1 is provisional: finalcomplete remains blocked pending calibration; no library or author selfcheck can waive this.
quality_gate: Ordinary review and export are insufficient: real independent quality evaluation and engine finish are separate. valuation-v1 final completion remains blocked pending calibration.
review_rounds: Fresh independent reviewer each round. Preserve original finding identities, but no original-reviewer-ID retention requirement. Explicit resolution/reopening evidence must bind each finding to current artifact hashes and actual independent review. Carry scoped unchanged accepted decisions and closed findings; allow real counterevidence.
